sources.entry: Domain Locker - Domain name portfolio management and tracker. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Deno/Docker

summary.one_liner: Domain Locker is a self-hostable domain name portfolio tracker that auto-fetches domain data (SSL, hosts, registrars, IPs, DNS, subdomains) and sends expiration and change alerts.
summary.what_it_does: It gives an overview of a portfolio of domain names in one place. For each added domain it fetches associated data such as SSL certificates, hosts, registrars, IPs, DNS records and subdomains, and it continuously monitors domains for configuration changes and upcoming expirations. Users can set alerts and webhook notifications, keep a change history per domain, and record purchase prices and renewal costs. The README also describes website uptime and performance monitoring, visual analytics across the portfolio, categories and linked resources, and import/export with REST, GraphQL, RSS, iCal and Prometheus access. Data is stored in SQLite by default, with Postgres as an option.
use_cases: monitor SSL certificates and DNS changes
get alerts before a domain expires
record domain registrar and renewal costs
how_to_run: Or use the docker-compose.yml file from the repository
notable: Self-hosted via a single Docker container with SQLite by default or Postgres optionally
Built-in scheduled jobs for daily domain updates, 15-minute uptime checks, and weekly monitoring data cleanup
Notification channels listed include webhook, email, SMS, Slack, Telegram and WhatsApp
Also offered as a managed hosted service at domain-locker.com with a free starter plan
Supports SSO and 2FA according to the feature list
caveats: Unofficial apps section in the README is unfilled (pending/planned only)
Managed instance at domain-locker.com is a hosted option; the README does not detail its paid tiers beyond a free starter plan
